llm_response.reason: Century Capital Trade exhibits multiple scam website traits: (1) It promises guaranteed, immediate returns and claims users can 'earn passively and get paid immediately.' (2) It emphasizes psychological triggers like testimonials of easy success and urgency to sign up for free. (3) The company claims worldwide regulation and multiple awards, but these are unverifiable; the WHOIS lookup shows no valid registration, which is suspicious for a supposed well-known investment firm. (4) The platform offers a broad range of financial products that legitimate sites usually separate. (5) There is excessive use of sales and urgency tactics and ambiguous privacy/legal statements. Collectively, this matches numerous characteristics of investment scams.
